# PHASE C v2 (see ARCHITECTURE_V2.md section 4)
# Dispatcher batches goods across days 21-28; stl_phase_c_good does
# EMA + rate cap + decay, conservation normalization, transport cost
# and GUI bookkeeping for one good across the whole market.

# Scope: country (market owner)

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = stl_phase_c_batch_idx } }
		set_variable = { name = stl_phase_c_batch_idx value = 0 }
	}
	# ===== batch 0: grain, fish, fabric, wood, groceries, clothes =====
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:stl_phase_c_batch_idx >= 1 } }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = grain }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = fish }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = fabric }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = wood }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = groceries }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = clothes }
	}
	# ===== batch 1: furniture, paper, merchant_marine, coal, iron, lead =====

	# ===== batch 4: engines, explosives, ammunition, small_arms, artillery, tanks =====

		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = engines }

		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = ammunition }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = small_arms }
		stl_phase_c_good = { GOODS = artillery }

	# ===== batch 5: aeroplanes, meat, fruit, sugar, tobacco, liquor =====
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_phase_c_batch_idx >= 5 NOT = { var:stl_phase_c_batch_idx >= 6 } }

	change_variable = { name = stl_phase_c_batch_idx add = 1 }

# Scope: country (market owner). GOODS = good key.
stl_phase_c_good = {

	# ===== clear old modifiers (refs were refreshed on day 8) =====
	market = {
		every_scope_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
					has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
				}
				var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
					remove_modifier = stl_export_$GOODS$
					remove_modifier = stl_import_$GOODS$
					remove_modifier = stl_transport_$GOODS$
					remove_modifier = stl_debug_base_$GOODS$
					remove_modifier = stl_debug_access_$GOODS$
				}
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_transport_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_transport_$GOODS$ }
			}
		}
	}

	# ===== sub-pass 3d: per-state trade amounts =====
	market = {
		every_scope_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
					has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
				}

				# previous applied trade (EMA input), then reset
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_old_export value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_old_export value = var:stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_old_import value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_old_import value = var:stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
				}
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }

				# --- exporters ---
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = stl_eff_export_$GOODS$
						has_variable = stl_max_wad_$GOODS$
						var:stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ > 0
						var:stl_max_wad_$GOODS$ > 0.01
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = var:stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ }
					# EMA toward the Phase B target
					set_local_variable = {
						name = stl_trade_amount
						value = {
							value = local_var:stl_trade_amount
							multiply = 0.8
							add = {
								value = local_var:stl_old_export
								multiply = 0.2
							}
						}
					}
					# rate cap
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_rate_cap value = { value = local_var:stl_old_export multiply = 0.9 } }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_rate_cap >= 40 } }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_rate_cap value = 40 }
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_cap_up value = { value = local_var:stl_old_export add = local_var:stl_rate_cap } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:stl_trade_amount > local_var:stl_cap_up }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = local_var:stl_cap_up }
					}
					set_variable = { name = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_trade_amount }
					var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = stl_export_$GOODS$
							multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { global_var:stl_debug_mode >= 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_debug_base value = var:stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = { name = stl_debug_base_$GOODS$ multiplier = stl_debug_base_multiplier }
						}
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_debug_access value = { value = var:stl_wad_$GOODS$ divide = var:stl_max_wad_$GOODS$ } }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = { name = stl_debug_access_$GOODS$ multiplier = stl_debug_access_multiplier }
						}
					}
				}

				# --- importers ---
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = stl_eff_import_$GOODS$
						has_variable = stl_max_was_$GOODS$
						var:stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ > 0
						var:stl_max_was_$GOODS$ > 0.01
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = var:stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ }
					set_local_variable = {
						name = stl_trade_amount
						value = {
							value = local_var:stl_trade_amount
							multiply = 0.8
							add = {
								value = local_var:stl_old_import
								multiply = 0.2
							}
						}
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_rate_cap value = { value = local_var:stl_old_import multiply = 0.9 } }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_rate_cap >= 40 } }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_rate_cap value = 40 }
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_cap_up value = { value = local_var:stl_old_import add = local_var:stl_rate_cap } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:stl_trade_amount > local_var:stl_cap_up }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = local_var:stl_cap_up }
					}
					set_variable = { name = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_trade_amount }
					var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
						add_modifier = {
							name = stl_import_$GOODS$
							multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { global_var:stl_debug_mode >= 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_debug_base value = var:stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = { name = stl_debug_base_$GOODS$ multiplier = stl_debug_base_multiplier }
						}
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_debug_access value = { value = var:stl_was_$GOODS$ divide = var:stl_max_was_$GOODS$ } }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = { name = stl_debug_access_$GOODS$ multiplier = stl_debug_access_multiplier }
						}
					}
				}

				# --- gradual decay when the Phase B signal disappears ---
				if = {
					limit = {
						local_var:stl_old_export > 0.5
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = { value = local_var:stl_old_export multiply = 0.8 } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:stl_trade_amount > 0.5 }
						set_variable = { name = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_trade_amount }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = {
								name = stl_export_$GOODS$
								multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						local_var:stl_old_import > 0.5
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
					}
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = { value = local_var:stl_old_import multiply = 0.8 } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:stl_trade_amount > 0.5 }
						set_variable = { name = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_trade_amount }
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							add_modifier = {
								name = stl_import_$GOODS$
								multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# ===== sub-pass 3d.5: conservation normalization =====
	set_global_variable = { name = stl_sum_exports value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = stl_sum_imports value = 0 }
	market = {
		every_scope_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
					has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
					set_global_variable = {
						name = stl_sum_exports
						value = { value = global_var:stl_sum_exports add = var:stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
					set_global_variable = {
						name = stl_sum_imports
						value = { value = global_var:stl_sum_imports add = var:stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = stl_norm_export value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = stl_norm_import value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:stl_sum_exports > 0
			global_var:stl_sum_imports > 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:stl_sum_imports > global_var:stl_sum_exports }
			set_global_variable = {
				name = stl_norm_import
				value = { value = global_var:stl_sum_exports divide = global_var:stl_sum_imports }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:stl_sum_exports > global_var:stl_sum_imports }
			set_global_variable = {
				name = stl_norm_export
				value = { value = global_var:stl_sum_imports divide = global_var:stl_sum_exports }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:stl_sum_exports > 0 }
			global_var:stl_sum_imports > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = stl_norm_import value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:stl_sum_exports > 0
			NOT = { global_var:stl_sum_imports > 0 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = stl_norm_export value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { global_var:stl_norm_export >= 1 }
				NOT = { global_var:stl_norm_import >= 1 }
			}
		}
		market = {
			every_scope_country = {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
						has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
					}
					# scale exports down
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$
							NOT = { global_var:stl_norm_export >= 1 }
						}
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							remove_modifier = stl_export_$GOODS$
						}
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_scaled value = { value = var:stl_last_export_$GOODS$ multiply = global_var:stl_norm_export } }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:stl_scaled > 0.5 }
							set_variable = { name = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_scaled }
							set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = local_var:stl_scaled }
							var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
								add_modifier = {
									name = stl_export_$GOODS$
									multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							# rounds to zero: drop it entirely (no phantom flows)
							if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
						}
					}
					# scale imports down
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$
							NOT = { global_var:stl_norm_import >= 1 }
						}
						var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
							remove_modifier = stl_import_$GOODS$
						}
						set_local_variable = { name = stl_scaled value = { value = var:stl_last_import_$GOODS$ multiply = global_var:stl_norm_import } }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:stl_scaled > 0.5 }
							set_variable = { name = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_scaled }
							set_local_variable = { name = stl_trade_amount value = local_var:stl_scaled }
							var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
								add_modifier = {
									name = stl_import_$GOODS$
									multiplier = stl_trade_multiplier
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							# rounds to zero: drop it entirely (fixes v0.1 phantom transport)
							if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# ===== sub-pass 3d.75: distance-based transport cost (importers) =====
	market = {
		every_scope_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
					has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
					has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$
					has_variable = stl_was_$GOODS$
					var:stl_was_$GOODS$ > 0.01
				}
				# cost factor = max_WAS / WAS, clamped to [1, 10]
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_distance_factor value = { value = var:stl_max_was_$GOODS$ divide = var:stl_was_$GOODS$ } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_distance_factor >= 1 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_distance_factor value = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:stl_distance_factor > 10 }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_distance_factor value = 10 }
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_transport_amount value = { value = var:stl_last_import_$GOODS$ multiply = local_var:stl_distance_factor } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_transport_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_transport_amount }
				var:stl_trade_depot_ref = {
					add_modifier = {
						name = stl_transport_$GOODS$
						multiplier = stl_transport_multiplier
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# ===== sub-pass 3e: access % + active-goods list for the GUI =====
	market = {
		every_scope_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stl_trade_depot_ref
					has_building = building_stl_trade_depot
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ var:stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ > 0.01 }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = { value = var:stl_last_export_$GOODS$ divide = var:stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ multiply = 100 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:stl_acc_pct > 100 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = 100 } }
					if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_acc_pct >= 0 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_access_export_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_acc_pct }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = stl_eff_export_$GOODS$ } NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ } } }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_access_export_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_access_export_$GOODS$ }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ var:stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ > 0.01 }
					set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = { value = var:stl_last_import_$GOODS$ divide = var:stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ multiply = 100 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:stl_acc_pct > 100 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = 100 } }
					if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_acc_pct >= 0 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_pct value = 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_access_import_$GOODS$ value = local_var:stl_acc_pct }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = stl_eff_import_$GOODS$ } NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ } } }
					if = { limit = { has_variable = stl_access_import_$GOODS$ } remove_variable = stl_access_import_$GOODS$ }
				}
				# membership in the GUI's active-goods list
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$
							has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$
						}
						NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = stl_active_goods target = flag:$GOODS$ } }
					}
					add_to_variable_list = { name = stl_active_goods target = flag:$GOODS$ }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_export_$GOODS$ }
						NOT = { has_variable = stl_last_import_$GOODS$ }
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = stl_active_goods target = flag:$GOODS$ }
					}
					remove_list_variable = { name = stl_active_goods target = flag:$GOODS$ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
